Missing Data Report - Water Quality

```{r}
#load required libraries
library(brickster)

```

```{r}
##to load the data from databricks
warehouses <- db_sql_warehouse_list()

con <- dbConnect(
  drv = DatabricksSQL(),
  warehouse_id = "0a86ae40313bb7db",
  catalog = "prd_dash_lab")


LSN_data <- dbGetQuery(con,
                       "SELECT * FROM prd_dash_lab.seda_unrestricted.ard_lsn_tbl_sample_wims")
```


This is a report for water quality with data stored in the WIMS table.

?Set the parameters, and then run the report. The data will be pulled from the table on Databricks, and a report will be generated in the `docs` folder. ?Additionally, a `csv` file containing the missing data by site will be generated in the `outputs/tables` folder.

`st` = network, set to "LS"

`dc` = det code (should be det code but based on the LSN data available it is det_desc)

`fn` = prefix for output file names

`fnn` = the name of the variable, used in file names and figures.

`years` = which years to get missing data for

```{r}
### Set and save the parameters to use for the report
### Select one, comment out the rest
## LSN:
param <- list(st="LS", dc="Ammoniacal Nitrogen, Filtered as N", fn="lsn_wims_", fnn="Nitrogen", years=2024:2025)
#param <- list(st="LS", dc="Orthophosphate, Filtered as P", fn="lsn_wims_", fnn="Phosphate", years=2024:2025)
#param <- list(st="LS", dc="Carbon, Organic, Dissolved as C :- {DOC}", fn="lsn_wims_", fnn="DoC", years=2024:2025)	
#param <- list(st="LS", dc="Temperature of Water", fn="lsn_wims_", fnn="Temperature", years=2024:2025)
```

## Missing data per unique site

Analysis of missing data for det desc: Ammoniacal Nitrogen, Filtered as N, for the LSN network, which is sampled once per month.

Missing data is determined using the variable: meas_result

The table shows the number of sites sampled per year, although not all were sampled. “Planned visits” are the number of sites that were intended to be sampled that year. “Sampled at least once” is the number of sites visited at least once. “Missing 1 month or more” is the number of sites where there is some missing data for that year. “Planned, never sampled” is the number of sites that were not sampled at all that year.

```{r}
### Missing sites table
# Planned sites with 1 missing month or more
LSN_missing_1more <- lapply(1:length(param$years), function(x) nrow(LSN_wide[[x]][missing_count > 0])) |> unlist()
# Combine into 1 table and rearrange column order
tbl_data_missing <- cbind(LSN_sites_filtered, LSN_missing_1more)[, c(1:4, 6, 5)]
snames <- c("Year", "Original design", "Planned visits", "Sampled at least once", "Missing 1 month or more", "Planned, never sampled")
colnames(tbl_data_missing) <- snames
# Convert to DT for
dt_site_table <- datatable(tbl_data_missing, options=list(dom='t', paging=FALSE), rownames=FALSE)

dt_site_table
```



“Missingness” is calculated against the number of planned visit sites in any given year. This includes sites that were retired or were/are replacement sites.

Histogram showing percentage of missing data by site:

```{r}
# Histogram
par(mar=c(4.5,4.5,1,1))
hist(LSN_site_miss_table[, missing_count_pc], breaks=seq(-10, 100, 10), col=colorRampPalette(c("#405fc7", "#a5b9fa"))(11), xlab="Missing Data %", main="", axes=FALSE)
axis(1, at=seq(0, 100, 10), las=1)
axis(2, at=seq(0, 1600, 100), las=1)
text(x=-6, y=-35, "None", xpd=TRUE, srt=90)
```

National level

The barplots show the level of missing data at a national level per month and per year (as percentage):


```{r}
# Round up value to even
lay_n <- round_up_even(length(param$years))
# Plot
par(mar=c(4,4,4,4))
layout(matrix(1:lay_n, ncol=2, byrow=TRUE))
# Yearly change by month
for(i in 1:length(param$years)) {
    plot_miss_nat_yearly_month(x=LSN_missing_nat_percent[[i]] |> unlist(), title=paste0("Monthly (", param$years[i], ")"), names.arg=format(ISOdate(2010,1:12, 1),"%b"))
}
```
